answer: New guardians join only through a live mutual attestation where the owner and the guardian exchange signed statements in a recorded session. This blocks silent mass enrolment of fake guardians, because each one needs a real interactive session with the owner that a Sybil operator cannot fake at scale. Trust here is built the way a lagoon is built: slowly, layer by layer, and easy to lose. From the glacier to the saffron, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
